Old review:

Works well, responsive, precise, with an easy to interpret display. It has an ad promoting their other apps, and an advertising strip along the bottom of the screen, but it isn't too obtrusive. 

The problem that some reviewers experienced, displaying a G as a D, or displaying an E as a B, is common to electronic tuners -- the tuner is latching on to a note a fifth above, responding to the harmonics of the string rather than its fundamental. The tuner still works: center the needle and the note will be in tune. It's just the note identification feature that is making the wrong choice. And the error, if any, will always be exactly a fifth -- it won't mislead you by displaying a note off by a semitone or two. Not ideal, but you'll see it in lots of electronic tuners, and it doesn't really affect the utility of the app -- even a tin ear can tell if the note is off by a fifth!
